subject: Multithreaded exraction of point values from raster

messages.author: 77b305de362e50ff
messages.subject: Multithreaded exraction of point values from raster
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to parallelize code for iteratively extracting values from individual bands of a multi-band temperature raster at a set of points. I'm using the `snowfall` package on a Windows x64 machine with  4 CPUs. Because snowfall can't iterate over layers in a `RasterStack` object, I converted the RasterStack into a list of `RasterLayer`s. When I use snowfall to apply the `raster::extract` function to this list, I receive the following error:

Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) : 
  3 nodes produced errors; first error: Error in open.ncdf trying to open file C:\Users\DYoung\R\multithread_extract\tmax_1998.nc

I believe this is because even once loaded, RasterLayer objects simply reference files until used in operations (is this right?) and the nodes are not able to access my computer's file system (is this also right?).

If this indeed what is happening, is there any way to make the nodes able to access my computer's file system? Or is there some other potential solution?

I have attached sample code that replicates this problem. You can download the multi-band raster it uses here (150 MB).

Thanks in advance,
Derek

--
Derek Young, Ph.D. Candidate
Graduate Group in Ecology
Department of Plant Sciences
University of California, Davis
http://www.changingforests.com
